description: Email address check without sending mail: RFC-style syntax validation, domain deliverability from MX (or A/AAAA fallback) over DNS-over-HTTPS, mail exchangers, disposable-domain and free-provider detection, role-based local parts (info, support, noreply), typo suggestion for common providers, plus-tag and canonical form (Gmail dots and tags removed), with a 0-100 score and a valid/risky/invalid verdict. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).
